events.title: Woodstock Festival anniversary
events.blurb: The legendary Woodstock Music & Art Fair began on this day in 1969, bringing together half a million people for "3 Days of Peace & Music."

angles.name: Woodstock Vibe
angles.copy: 57 years ago today, the Woodstock Festival kicked off. An iconic moment in music history – if you were there, what was your highlight?

events.title: Remembering Elvis Presley
events.blurb: The King of Rock & Roll, Elvis Presley, passed away on this day in 1977. He would have been 91 this year.

angles.name: Elvis Tribute
angles.copy: On this day in 1977, we lost the incomparable Elvis Presley. The King would have been 91 this year, and his music continues to define generations. What's your favourite Elvis track?

events.title: Remembering Tupac Shakur
events.blurb: Influential rapper Tupac Shakur was fatally shot in Las Vegas on this day in 1996. He would have been 55 this year.

angles.name: Tupac Tribute
angles.copy: 30 years ago today, the music world lost a true icon. Remembering Tupac Shakur, whose powerful lyrics and impact are still felt today. He would have been 55.

events.title: Remembering Jimi Hendrix
events.blurb: Guitar legend Jimi Hendrix passed away on this day in 1970. He would have been 84 this year.

angles.name: Jimi Hendrix Tribute
angles.copy: Today marks 56 years since we lost the extraordinary Jimi Hendrix. His groundbreaking guitar work continues to inspire. What's your go-to Hendrix track?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: The Pretenders' iconic frontwoman Chrissie Hynde celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Chrissie Hynde Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 75th birthday to the brilliant Chrissie Hynde! From The Pretenders' classics to her solo work, her voice is unmistakable. Which Pretenders song is your favourite?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Oasis frontman and rock 'n' roll star Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Liam Gallagher Birthday
angles.copy: Our Kid turns 54 today! Happy birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher. What's your favourite Oasis anthem or solo track from the rock 'n' roll star?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' UK single anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic anthem 'Imagine' was officially released as a single in the UK on this day in 1975.

angles.name: Imagine Anniversary
angles.copy: On this day in 1975, John Lennon's powerful message of peace, 'Imagine', was released as a UK single. Its impact resonates just as strongly today.

events.title: First iPod released
events.blurb: Apple unveiled the original iPod on this day in 2001, revolutionising how we listen to music on the go.

angles.name: iPod Nostalgia
angles.copy: Remember the first iPod? 25 years ago today, Apple dropped this game-changer and put '1,000 songs in your pocket'. How many songs did you cram onto yours?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: James Bond Day marks the anniversary of the world premiere of the first 007 film, Dr. No, in 1962.

angles.name: Bond Day
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Celebrating 007's cinematic debut with 'Dr. No' in 1962. Who's your favourite Bond, and what's the ultimate Bond theme tune?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Legendary musician John Lennon would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: John Lennon Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the visionary John Lennon, who would have been 86 today. His songs continue to inspire peace and imagination across the globe. What's your favourite Lennon lyric?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Comedy legend John Cleese, of Monty Python and Fawlty Towers fame, celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: John Cleese Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From 'Monty Python' to 'Fawlty Towers', his comedic genius is timeless. What's your favourite Cleese moment?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: Queen's iconic frontman Freddie Mercury passed away on this day in 1991. He would have been 80 this year.

angles.name: Freddie Mercury Tribute
angles.copy: 35 years ago today, the world lost a legend: Freddie Mercury. His incredible stage presence and vocal power remain unmatched. What's your favourite Queen song?
